free_tier.correction: false — the current Free plan requires adding a payment method and purchasing credits before running requests

free_tier_limits.correction: The no-payment Free rate-limit class is published as 20 RPM, 20 RPD, and 200,000 TPD for each listed eligible model, but it does not provide included free API credits

rate_limits.correction: Rate limits are published by model and tier. Free-listed models have 20 RPM, 20 RPD, and 200,000 TPD; Developer limits vary by model from 60–240 RPM and 12,000–48,000 RPD, with 20 million tokens per day across all models

example.correction: The endpoint, Bearer header, JSON body, and implicit POST are consistent with current documentation, but Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct was removed from SambaCloud on April 14, 2026. Use a current model such as Meta-Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct

description.correction: SambaCloud is an RDU-powered, high-throughput inference platform for large open-source models. It provides self-service API keys and OpenAI-compatible APIs, including Chat Completions and Responses, with production and preview model tiers

notes: Current official pricing no longer includes free API credits. The documentation still uses “Free Tier” for the lower no-payment rate-limit class, which is distinct from free usage. The submitted example also names a model removed in April 2026.
